album.title: Radif of Persian Music on Setar I

just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on C3 and dwells most on F in Bayat Raje. The line peaks at G4 (412.8 Hz) at 1:40.9. It closes on C3, not the tonic (Bb3 → C4 → C3 → C3 → Bb3 → C3).
